# `Q-24-6` — Paragraph-Mark Changes Dropped

> Tracked insertions or deletions of paragraph breaks were not imported.

## What this means

Word can track the insertion or deletion of a paragraph break itself. The importer has no editorial mark for a paragraph break, so these were dropped; the text on either side is imported as written.

## Why this happens

- The document has tracked changes that added or removed paragraph breaks.

## How to fix

Nothing needs fixing. Compare against the original document if the paragraph structure matters.
